# CAN DESIGN WEB STUDIO

> CAN DESIGN WEB STUDIO designs and builds websites for shops and businesses in Thailand: online shops, business sites, Thai–English, LINE ordering and booking, made for phones. Try 18 working sample sites before you hire. From 1,490 baht.

CAN DESIGN WEB STUDIO รับทำเว็บไซต์ ออกแบบเว็บร้านค้าออนไลน์และเว็บธุรกิจ สองภาษาไทย–อังกฤษ เชื่อมต่อ LINE รับออเดอร์และจองคิว ใช้ง่ายบนมือถือ มีเว็บตัวอย่าง 18 แบบให้ลองใช้ก่อนจ้าง ราคาเริ่มต้น 1,490 บาท

## About
CAN DESIGN WEB STUDIO is a web design studio for shops and businesses in Thailand. We design and build online shops, business websites and admin systems. Every site does real work — pricing, booking and ordering through LINE — switches between Thai and English, and is made for phones. You can try working sample sites before you hire, prices are clear from the start, and the site and domain are yours.

CAN DESIGN WEB STUDIO คือสตูดิโอรับทำเว็บไซต์สำหรับร้านค้าและธุรกิจในประเทศไทย ออกแบบและพัฒนาเว็บร้านค้าออนไลน์ เว็บแนะนำธุรกิจ และระบบหลังบ้าน ทุกเว็บใช้งานได้จริง ทั้งคิดราคา จองคิว และรับออเดอร์ผ่าน LINE สลับภาษาไทยและอังกฤษได้ และออกแบบให้ใช้ง่ายบนมือถือ ก่อนจ้างคุณลองใช้เว็บตัวอย่างได้ทันที ราคาบอกชัดตั้งแต่แรก และเว็บกับโดเมนเป็นของคุณ

- Online shops, business websites and admin systems / รับทำเว็บไซต์ร้านค้าออนไลน์ เว็บธุรกิจ และระบบหลังบ้าน
- For cafés, restaurants, hotels, clinics, beauty salons, tutoring schools, trades, property, tours and wholesale factories / สำหรับคาเฟ่ ร้านอาหาร โรงแรม คลินิก ร้านความงาม โรงเรียนกวดวิชา ช่าง อสังหาฯ ทัวร์ และโรงงานขายส่ง
- LINE ordering and booking, Thai and English / เชื่อมต่อ LINE รับออเดอร์และจองคิว สองภาษาไทย–อังกฤษ
- We work with you over LINE and Facebook, anywhere in Thailand / คุยงานผ่าน LINE และ Facebook รับงานทั่วประเทศ

## Real work
- CherryMing Shop (Online shop · Fashion): A shop for shoes, clothing and accessories, for Thai and international customers. Storefront and admin system built together as one site. — https://cherryming.shop

## Services
- Online shops: Products, prices, stock, a cart and orders — for retail, or wholesale with prices by quantity.
- Business websites: One page or several, for restaurants, clinics, companies and service businesses.
- Admin system: Add products, change photos, edit wording and see orders yourself. No code needed.
- LINE integration: Customers tap to order and land in your LINE chat, with automatic order-status messages.
- Built for phones: Easy to read and easy to tap on a small screen — where most customers will see it.
- After-launch care: A user guide comes with the site, and changes or new sections can be added later.

## Pricing (Thai baht)
- Starter: ฿1,490 — Pick one of the 18 designs, with your shop's details. One-page site in the design you choose; That design's features, such as pricing and booking; .com domain and hosting for 1 year; Delivered in 3 days once we have your content; Free changes for 14 days after delivery
- Custom: ฿4,900 — Colours, logo and features made your own. Everything in Starter; Colours, fonts and layout to match your brand; Features fitted to your shop: prices, slots, menu; Two languages, Thai and English; Delivered in 7 days, free changes for 30 days
- Multi-page + admin: from ฿19,000 — For businesses that update often. 5–8 pages, designed from scratch; Admin area to edit text, photos and news yourself; Two languages, Thai and English; Training and a user guide
- Full online shop: from ฿45,000 — The same kind of system as CherryMing Shop. Products, stock, cart and orders; Ordering and status updates through LINE; Coupons, free gifts, wholesale price tiers; Full admin for products and orders

## Sample sites to try (18)
- [Cafés & restaurants](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/cafe/index.html): Menu by category, order ahead with a running total, and an open-now badge
- [Hotels & hostels](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/hostel/index.html): Pick dates and a room — nights, discount and total are worked out for you
- [Tours & activities](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/tour/index.html): Pick a tour and date — adults, children and hotel pick-up priced for you, seats checked — then book on LINE
- [Spas & massage](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/spa/index.html): Tap a treatment, day, time and number of people to see the total at once
- [Nail salons](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/nails/index.html): Tick services, enter how many nails get art, pick a colour and see the estimate
- [Beauty clinics](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/clinic/index.html): A booking form that checks itself, time slots, and an FAQ
- [Dental clinics](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/dental/index.html): An appointment calendar showing free and taken slots for each day
- [Tutoring schools](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/tutor/index.html): Filter courses by level and add up the fees, discount included
- [Builders & trades](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/contractor/index.html): A price estimate from job type, area and material grade, and past work by category
- [Gyms & yoga studios](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/gym/index.html): A daily class timetable with places left, class booking, and membership priced by contract length
- [Pet grooming & hotels](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/pet/index.html): Choose the pet, its size, the services and nights of boarding — the price follows
- [Real estate](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/property/index.html): Filter and sort listings to rent or buy, arrange a viewing, and a mortgage calculator
- [Photography studios](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/photo/index.html): A gallery filtered by category with a full-screen viewer, and a package builder with add-ons
- [Car rental](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/carrental/index.html): Pick-up and return times counted into rental days, cars filtered by seats, and extras added up
- [Florists & cake shops](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/cake/index.html): Design your own cake and watch it change with the size, colour, message and candles you choose
- [Accounting firms](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/accounting/index.html): A monthly fee estimate from the size of the business, and the tax deadlines coming up
- [Car repair garages](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/garage/index.html): Tick repair jobs to see cost and time, and check what is due at your car's mileage
- [Wholesale factories](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/demos/wholesale/index.html): Buy more, pay less: type a quantity to see each price step, build a quote, send it on LINE

## Articles
- [How much does a shop website cost, and what to ask before you hire](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/website-cost.html): Website prices run from a few thousand baht to hundreds of thousands. What makes the difference is what the site can do and what you get to keep. These are the questions to ask anyone before you decide.
- [You already have a Facebook page — why your shop still needs a website](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/website-vs-facebook-page.html): A Facebook page is good for talking to customers, but a website gets you found on Google and AI search, sells in an orderly way, and is a place you own.
- [What to prepare before getting a shop website: a 7-point checklist](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/prepare-before-website.html): The more you have ready, the faster and closer to what you want the site will be. Here is what to gather before you talk to a web designer — from your logo and product photos to a domain name.
- [How a website connects to LINE for orders — one tap sends the order to your shop](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/website-line-oa-orders.html): Thai customers already order through LINE. A website connected to LINE lets them choose on the site and send every detail to the shop's chat in one go.
- [Domains and hosting: what they are, how they differ, and what they cost each year](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/domain-and-hosting.html): Two words you hear whenever a website is made. The domain is the site's name; hosting is where the site lives. Understand both and you'll know what you pay next year — and why the domain should be in your own name.
- [A Thai–English website: which businesses need one](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/bilingual-website.html): If your customers include foreigners, tourists or overseas partners, a two-language site lets them understand and decide without translating.
- [Getting your shop found on Google and AI search: 6 basics a small shop can do](https://jarucherry.github.io/can-design-web-studio/articles/get-found-on-google.html): You don't need complicated techniques. Get the basics right and even a small shop can appear in search results and be recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT.

## Questions
### Can I see samples of your work?
Yes, right now, without asking. Eighteen sample sites and a real client site are here to open and use in full.

### What does the site do, beyond being looked at?
It works out prices, takes bookings and menu choices, and sends the details to your LINE. Your customers order in a few taps instead of typing question after question.

### Can foreign customers read it?
Every site switches between Thai and English with one button, including the message sent to LINE.

### How does it look on a phone?
Every page is designed for and tested on a phone screen — where most customers will open it.

### Who owns the site and the domain?
You do. The domain is registered in your name and all the site files are handed over. You can move elsewhere at any time; nothing ties you to us.

### What will it cost next year?
You are told on day one. Domain and hosting renewal is 790 baht a year. No costs that turn up later.
